message.content:
The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**.  
It was discovered around the young star HD 100546 (about 320 light‑years away) and has a radius roughly 2½–3 times that of Jupiter—making it one of the biggest gas giants ever found.  

Because our observations are limited to what we can detect with current telescopes, it’s possible that even bigger planets exist out there that we haven’t seen yet. But as of now, HD 100546 b holds the record for the largest known planet.
